title: Tara Calico
subtitle: Belen, New Mexico · 1988
voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.
grade: Desaturated documentary still, the high desert of central New Mexico in the late 1980s, flat mesa, two-lane highway, juniper and dry grass, pale washed-out sunlight and dusty amber tones, melancholy and quiet, cinematic wide composition, fine film grain. Single image, not a collage, no text, no signage, no people, no faces, no children, no photographs.

beats.vo: Belen, New Mexico. September twentieth, nineteen eighty-eight. Nineteen-year-old Tara Calico left home at nine-thirty for a bike ride on Highway forty-seven.
beats.img: A long empty two-lane desert highway running north across flat high-desert mesa in the clear morning light, a narrow paved shoulder, dry grass and scattered juniper, distant blue mountains, no vehicles.

beats.vo: She asked her mother to pick her up if she wasn't home by noon.
beats.img: A quiet suburban front porch in a small New Mexico town at late morning, an empty bicycle rack beside the door, harsh sun, long shadow of a porch post, a wall clock visible through a screen door, no people.

beats.vo: Witnesses saw an older pickup truck following close behind her. No one saw what happened next. Neither Tara nor her bicycle was ever found.
beats.img: The empty shoulder of a desert highway at midday, faint thin tire marks in the dust at the edge of the pavement, a barbed-wire fence and open mesa beyond, heat haze, nothing else.

beats.vo: In nineteen eighty-nine, a Polaroid found in Florida was thought by some to show her. Its identification was never confirmed.
beats.img: A plain manila case file folder lying closed on a worn wooden desk under a single desk lamp at night, a magnifying loupe beside it, nothing visible on the folder, dim and quiet.

beats.vo: In twenty twenty-three, the sheriff sent the case to prosecutors. No one has ever been charged.
beats.img: The same empty desert highway at dusk, stretching north toward dark mountains under a deep violet sky, the last light on the pavement, still and unresolved.

facts.claim: Tara Calico, 19, of Belen/Rio Communities NM, left home around 9:30 a.m. on Sept 20, 1988 for a bike ride on NM Highway 47
She told her mother to come look for her if she was not home by noon
Witnesses reported an older pickup truck (possibly a 1950s Ford with camper shell) following closely behind her
Neither Tara nor her bicycle has ever been found

In June 1989 a Polaroid found in a parking lot in Port St. Joe, Florida was believed by her mother/others to show her; analyses (Scotland Yard, FBI, Los Alamos) conflicted or were inconclusive; identification never established
June 2023: Valencia County Sheriff sent the case file to the 13th Judicial District Attorney for possible charges; suspects' identities sealed
As of Sept 2025 and Jan 2026 reporting, no charges filed (case not declined); still listed missing by NCMEC
